verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The four astronauts on NASA’s Artemis II mission" (R2); "The Artemis II crew consists of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen" (R3); "commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state the crew has four astronauts.

verifications.claim: The commander of the Artemis II crew is Reid Wiseman of NASA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Artemis II mission is commanded by NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman" (R2); "Commander Reid Wiseman" (R3, R4, R5, R9)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm Reid Wiseman (NASA) as commander.

verifications.claim: The pilot of the Artemis II crew is Victor Glover of NASA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NASA astronaut Victor Glover is the pilot" (R2); "Pilot Victor Glover" (R3, R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm Victor Glover (NASA) as pilot.

verifications.claim: One mission specialist of the Artemis II crew is Christina Hammock Koch of NASA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NASA astronaut Christina Hammock Koch... mission specialist" (R2); "Mission Specialist Christina Koch" (R3, R4, R5, R9)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm Christina Hammock Koch (NASA) as mission specialist.

verifications.claim: One mission specialist of the Artemis II crew is Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen are mission specialists" (R2); "Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen" (R3, R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm Jeremy Hansen (CSA) as mission specialist.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is set to fly a 10-day mission around the Moon in April 2026.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "10-day journey around the moon... launch April 1-4" (R2); "March 2026 (target)" (R3); "April 1, 2026... 10-day journey around the Moon" (R5); "liftoff as early as 6:24 p.m. Wednesday, April 1" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources support 10-day lunar flyby in April 2026, but R3 specifies March 2026 target, creating contradiction on date.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed lunar flyby in more than half a century" (R3); "first crewed mission... first time in over 50 years" (R4); "first time in more than 50 years" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently describe it as the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo over 50 years ago.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman is a US Navy veteran.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Naval aviator and test pilot" (R2); "naval aviator and veteran" (R3); "Naval Aviator in 1999" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm US Navy service as aviator.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman is a former Chief of the Astronaut Office.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wiseman was chief of the astronaut office... 2020 through 2022" (R2); "commanded NASA Astronaut Office" (R3); "chief of the Astronaut Office from December 2020 until November 2022" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will be Reid Wiseman's second spaceflight.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "went to the International Space Station... in 2014" (R2); "flew previously... Expedition 41" (R4); "spent six months aboard the International Space Station in 2014" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm prior ISS flight in 2014, making Artemis II the second.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman had a stay on the International Space Station in 2014.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "went to the International Space Station on Russia’s Soyuz rocket in 2014" (R2); "Expedition 41 from May through November 2014" (R4); "International Space Station in 2014" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated in sources.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover is a US Navy captain.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "former U.S. Navy captain" (R7); "Navy aviator" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly states US Navy captain; others confirm Navy service.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover is a test pilot.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Naval aviator and test pilot" (R2); "Navy test pilot" (R3, R4); "Navy aviator and test pilot" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as test pilot.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover piloted the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot on NASA’s SpaceX Crew-1" (R4); "Glover was the pilot for the Crew-1 mission" (R8); "went to... SpaceX Crew-1 mission" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Directly confirmed as pilot of Crew-1.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover will be the first Black person to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first Black man to fly around the moon" (R2); "first person of color to go to the Moon" (R4); "first person of color" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm as first Black/person of color on lunar mission (beyond LEO).

verifications.claim: Christina Hammock Koch is an electrical engineer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering... Master of Science in Electrical Engineering" (R1); "electrical engineering and physics degrees" (R2); "Electrical engineer" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Degrees and profession explicitly electrical engineering.

verifications.claim: Christina Hammock Koch set a record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "set a record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman with a total of 328 days" (R1); "longest continuous spaceflight by a woman (328 days)" (R3); "longest single spaceflight for a woman" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated across sources.

verifications.claim: Christina Hammock Koch will be the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Koch will be the first woman" (R2); "first woman to go to the Moon" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first woman on lunar mission (beyond LEO).

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R2, R3, R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently identified as CSA astronaut.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is a former fighter pilot.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilots who earned advanced STEM degrees" (R2); "Fighter pilot" (R3); "fighter pilot in the Royal Canadian Air Force, flying CF-18 fighter jets" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as fighter pilot.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen will be the first non-American to fly on a lunar mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Hansen will be the first Canadian" (R2, R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: First Canadian on lunar mission implies first non-American, as prior missions were all American.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will test the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test the spacecraft’s life support systems" (R2); "test deep‑space propulsion, life‑support" (R3); "test the Orion spacecraft’s life support systems" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will fly farther from Earth than any human in history
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farther from Earth than humans have ever traveled, surpassing the Apollo 13 mission that traveled 248,655 miles" (R2); "farther from Earth than any human has ever ventured, surpassing the Apollo 13 distance record of 248,655 miles" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated, surpassing Apollo 13 record.
